sql.where:
n.is_public = 'Y'
AND n.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND DBMS_LOB.INSTR(n.content, #{keyword}) > 0
AND ( n.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR DBMS_LOB.INSTR(n.content, #{keyword}) > 0 )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM NOTICE n JOIN MEMBER m ON n.created_by = m.member_id

SELECT n.notice_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(n.title, '<', '<'), '>', '>') title, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(n.content, 120, 1) content, n.is_public, n.created_by, TO_CHAR(n.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') created_at, TO_CHAR(n.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') updated_at, m.name FROM NOTICE n JOIN MEMBER m ON n.created_by = m.member_id
ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC OFFSET #{skip} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT n.notice_id, n.title, n.content, n.is_public, n.created_by, TO_CHAR(n.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') created_at, TO_CHAR(n.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') updated_at, m.name FROM NOTICE n JOIN MEMBER m ON n.created_by = m.member_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{notice_id} AND n.is_public = 'Y'
